newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading in Samlip shr halted on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Samlip shr halted on rumours.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said it had suspended from Thursday morning trading in shares of Samlip General Foods Co amid rumours that the company plans to file for court receivership.
A public information official at the exchange said the exchange would decide on how long the trading halt would continue after getting a statement from the company.

Officials at Samlip were not immediately available for comment. A telephone operator at the company's switchboard said executives could not be reached because they were holding a regular morning meeting.
Samlip shares last traded on Tuesday, finishing the day at 14,300 won. The Seoul stock market was closed on Wednesday for Buddha's birthday.
